commands.name: help
commands.description: Show list of all available commands.

commands.name: bases
commands.description: List all `.base` files in the vault.

commands.name: base:views
commands.description: List views in the current base file.

commands.name: base:create
commands.description: Create a new item in a base. Defaults to the active base view if no file is specified.

commands.name: base:query
commands.description: Query a base and return results.

commands.name: daily:path
commands.description: Get daily note path. Returns the expected path even if the file hasn't been created yet.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: List or compare versions from local [[File recovery]] and [[Introduction to Obsidian Sync|Sync]]. Versions are numbered from newest to oldest.

commands.name: history
commands.description: List versions from [[File recovery]] only. See [[#Sync|sync:history]] for the equivalent Sync command.

commands.name: history:list
commands.description: List all files with local history.

commands.name: append
commands.description: Append content to a file (default: active file).

commands.name: prepend
commands.description: Prepend content after frontmatter (default: active file).

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move or rename a file (default: active file). This will automatically update [[internal links]] if turned on in your [[Settings#Automatically update internal links|vault settings]].

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Rename a file (default: active file). The file extension is preserved automatically if omitted from the new name. Use [[#`move`|move]] to rename and move a file at the same time. This will automatically update [[internal links]] if turned on in your [[Settings#Automatically update internal links|vault settings]].

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a file (default: active file, trash by default).

commands.name: backlinks
commands.description: List backlinks to a file (default: active file).

commands.name: links
commands.description: List outgoing links from a file (default: active file).

commands.name: orphans
commands.description: List files with no incoming links.

commands.name: deadends
commands.description: List files with no outgoing links.

commands.name: outline
commands.description: Show headings for the current file.

commands.name: aliases
commands.description: List aliases in the vault. Use `active` or `file`/`path` to show aliases for a specific file.

commands.name: properties
commands.description: List properties in the vault. Use `active` or `file`/`path` to show properties for a specific file.

commands.name: property:set
commands.description: Set a property on a file (default: active file).

commands.name: property:remove
commands.description: Remove a property from a file (default: active file).

commands.name: property:read
commands.description: Read a property value from a file (default: active file).

commands.name: publish:add
commands.description: Publish a file or all changed files (default: active file).

commands.name: publish:open
commands.description: Open file on published site (default: active file).

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search vault for text. Returns matching file paths.

commands.name: search:context
commands.description: Search with matching line context. Returns grep-style `path:line: text` output.

commands.name: sync:history
commands.description: List sync version history for a file (default: active file).

commands.name: sync:read
commands.description: Read a sync version (default: active file).

commands.name: sync:restore
commands.description: Restore a sync version (default: active file).

commands.name: tags
commands.description: List tags in the vault. Use `active` or `file`/`path` to show tags for a specific file.

commands.name: tasks
commands.description: List tasks in the vault. Use `active` or `file`/`path` to show tasks for a specific file.

flags.name: verbose
flags.description: group by file with line numbers

commands.name: theme
commands.description: Show active theme or get info.

commands.name: vault:open
commands.description: Switch to a different vault (TUI only).

commands.name: wordcount
commands.description: Count words and characters (default: active file).

commands.name: dev:cdp
commands.description: Run a Chrome DevTools Protocol command.

flags.name: all
flags.description: return all matches instead of first
